When a garden is created via CreateGardenSheet or a plant is added via AddPlantToGardenSheet, the MyGardenView does not reload its data after the sheet dismisses. This means newly created gardens won't show in the garden selector, and newly added plants won't appear in the plant grid until the user manually pulls to refresh. Root cause: loadData() only runs once via .task on view appear, with no mechanism to reload when sheets close. Partial fix added: .onChange(of: showingCreateGarden/showingAddPlant) handlers, but these may not be sufficient depending on timing.
